name: A+B?
title: A. A+B?
legend: You are given an expression of the form a+b, where a and b are integers from 0 to 9. You have to evaluate it and print the result.
input_spec:
The first line contains one integer t (1≤t≤100) — the number of test cases.

Each test case consists of one line containing an expression of the form a+b (0≤a,b≤9, both a and b are integers). The integers are not separated from the + sign.
output_spec: For each test case, print one integer — the result of the expression.
